entities.name: Distal femoral arrest estimate
observations: For a typical 14-year-old boy, assuming about two years of remaining growth and 0.9–1.0 cm/year distal femoral growth, complete arrest predicts approximately 1.8–2.0 cm of future leg-length discrepancy.
